runtimePrecision.runtimeMemoryNote: Original and BF16 weights use about 1.25 GB of VRAM while active; FP32 uses about 2.51 GB. Buffers and runtime workspaces add to this. RAM standby moves weights to system RAM. The 164 MB figure is the original packed download.
runtimePrecision.runtimeComponent: Original uses GPU BF16 execution decoded from its five-value checkpoint. BF16 and FP32 are created from the same compact checkpoint; either selection is not a second model download. Packed CPU kernels are not used for dictation.

models.note: Requires the dedicated llama.cpp-omni runtime for audio, speech and full-duplex conversation. Pack includes one backbone, the F16 audio/vision/TTS components and token2wav models. The app has no built-in Omni adapter; optional checkpoint download does not enable chat, dictation or streaming. Publisher documents 12 GB NVIDIA configurations for its reference runtime; local memory, latency and Windows support are unverified. Published component precision is preserved.

models.label: Qwen 3 Omni · Audio Captioner
models.description: Official Qwen3 Omni model for detailed audio descriptions.
models.note: Specialized single-turn model: audio input only and text output only; no text prompts or speech synthesis. Publisher recommends one audio clip of at most 30 seconds. Requires the Qwen3 Omni compatible Transformers/vLLM runtime and qwen-omni-utils. App has no built-in audio captioning adapter; full weights exceed 12 GB GPU residency and local inference is unverified.

models.note: The publisher provides MLX affine 4-bit weights, not a Windows GGUF. Install downloads the exact source checkpoint and tokenizer. BF16 storage reconstructs the published quantized values; it does not recover original full precision.

models.label: OctLLM · 11.1B
models.description: Generate textured 3D objects from text or images, and understand existing 3D shapes.
models.note: Official Qwen2.5-VL-based checkpoint with custom 3D branches and occupancy completion. Generates textured GLB meshes and supports 3D understanding. Optional checkpoint download only: about 22.5 GB, before separate TRELLIS decoders and CLIP weights. Publisher requires Linux x86_64, conda, an NVIDIA GPU and its custom loading code. The BF16 weights alone exceed 12 GB VRAM. OpenCore has no verified Windows adapter; downloading this package does not enable chat or generation. No weights are downloaded automatically.

models.label: WorldGen
models.description: Create explorable 360° indoor or outdoor 3D scenes from a text prompt or image.
models.note: Scene generation with Gaussian-splat PLY export or mesh output. This requested repository mirrors LeoXie/WorldGen and contains only two FLUX LoRA adapters (79.6 MB combined), not the complete model. The adapters match the upstream files by SHA256. Running WorldGen also requires the upstream pipeline, separate FLUX base weights with publisher access approval and separate license terms, depth estimation and 3D dependencies. The publisher reports a roughly 10 GB low-VRAM mode; local speed and Windows compatibility are unverified. OpenCore offers the adapter download only, with no built-in generation adapter. No weights are downloaded automatically.

models.label: Iris 3B
models.description: Text-to-image generation directly in pixel space, without a separate VAE.
models.note: Base text-to-image model, normally 100 sampling steps at CFG 3 and about one megapixel. Downloads only the base checkpoint and config, not the depth, upscaling or Turbo checkpoints. The frozen Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder is a separate dependency. Optional publisher checkpoint download only. Requires the Iris custom PyTorch runtime, Python 3.11+ and CUDA; no managed OpenCore generation adapter is verified. No weights are downloaded automatically.

runtimePrecision.runtimeMemoryNote: Approximate model weights only. The separate Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder, activations and CUDA buffers add memory; a 3B label alone does not establish device fit.
runtimePrecision.runtimeComponent: Publisher Iris pixel-space sampler and separate Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder

models.label: Iris 3B Turbo
models.description: Four-step distilled Iris image generator with a smaller BF16 download.
models.note: Full 3B distilled checkpoint, not a LoRA. Its fixed four-step schedule requires turbo/distill.yaml; steps, CFG and negative-prompt controls do not apply. Shares the separate Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder requirement with the base model. The published sampler upcasts its weights to FP32. Optional publisher checkpoint download only. Requires the Iris custom PyTorch runtime, Python 3.11+ and CUDA; no managed OpenCore generation adapter is verified. No weights are downloaded automatically.

runtimePrecision.runtimeMemoryNote: The roughly 6 GB BF16 checkpoint is upcast to FP32 by the published sampler, so resident Iris weights are about 12 GB before the separate 4B text encoder, activations and CUDA buffers. Smaller download does not mean a 6 GB complete runtime.
runtimePrecision.runtimeComponent: Publisher Iris pixel-space sampler and separate Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder

models.label: Iris 3B Depth
models.description: Estimate relative monocular depth from an image; output a depth array and colorized preview.
models.note: Separate image-conditioned task checkpoint with its own config and empty-prompt tensor. Runs in one forward pass without the text encoder. Depth is relative, not metric, and does not produce a textured 3D mesh. Optional publisher checkpoint download only. Requires the Iris custom PyTorch runtime, Python 3.11+ and CUDA; no managed OpenCore generation adapter is verified. No weights are downloaded automatically.

runtimePrecision.runtimeMemoryNote: Approximate FP32 model weights only, plus the supplied empty-prompt tensor and runtime buffers. This image task does not need the separate text encoder.
runtimePrecision.runtimeComponent: Publisher Iris single-pass image task

models.label: Iris 3B Upscaler
models.description: Restore degraded images and upscale them four times using a dedicated Iris checkpoint.
models.note: Separate image-conditioned task checkpoint with its own config and empty-prompt tensor. Runs in one forward pass without the text encoder. Restoration produces a 4x image and tiles large outputs into overlapping windows. Optional publisher checkpoint download only. Requires the Iris custom PyTorch runtime, Python 3.11+ and CUDA; no managed OpenCore generation adapter is verified. No weights are downloaded automatically.

models.label: Qwen3.8 27B S Mirai · GGUF
models.description: Community GGUF of Mirai S 27B, preserving its compressed trellis codes.
models.note: This custom GGUF preserves the original Mirai S trellis codes; it is not a standard IQ2 or Q2 quantization. Requires a Mirai S-compatible fork with custom ggml tensor types 90-93. OpenCore bundled llama.cpp cannot load this format, so native chat selection stays disabled. The publisher provides a separate Windows mirai-s-ada server; after preparing it, its local endpoint can be connected through OpenCore OpenAI-compatible API settings. The roughly 11.2 GB file includes an MTP block; full RAM/VRAM and speed depend on that runtime and context. Optional checkpoint download only; no runtime or weights are installed automatically.

models.label: Qwen3.8 27B S Mirai · GGUF + vision
models.description: The Mirai S custom GGUF with its matching Qwen3.8 F16 image projector.
models.note: This custom GGUF preserves the original Mirai S trellis codes; it is not a standard IQ2 or Q2 quantization. Requires a Mirai S-compatible fork with custom ggml tensor types 90-93. OpenCore bundled llama.cpp cannot load this format, so native chat selection stays disabled. The publisher provides a separate Windows mirai-s-ada server; after preparing it, its local endpoint can be connected through OpenCore OpenAI-compatible API settings. The roughly 11.2 GB file includes an MTP block; full RAM/VRAM and speed depend on that runtime and context. Optional checkpoint download only; no runtime or weights are installed automatically. This optional vision package adds the matching F16 projector (about 0.93 GB); it still requires multimodal support in the compatible fork.
